rules: Use Playfair Display for all H1-H3 headings to establish premium authority.
Use Public Sans for all body text and UI elements for maximum legibility.
Use JetBrains Mono for all financial data, numbers, and tickers.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase with wide tracking (0.1em).

primary.description: Deep Navy/Slate for text and primary actions.

background.description: Pure White for clarity, Deepest Obsidian for premium dark mode.

accent_primary.description: Wealth Green. Rich Emerald in light mode, Glowing Jade in dark mode.

accent_secondary.description: Antique Gold. Use sparingly for 'Premium' badges, high-tier pricing, and borders.

surface.description: Subtle slate for cards and sidebars.

about_team.alt: Financial advisors meeting in a modern office

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px for elegance, 2px for active states

general: Implement the 'Old Money Futurist' theme: Classic Serif headings paired with ultra-modern, data-dense dashboards.
Ensure Dark Mode is not just 'grey' but a deep, rich Obsidian/Navy (#020617) to make the Emerald accents pop.
Use 'Playfair Display' for all major headings. You must import this font from Google Fonts.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numbers, tickers, and financial data.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid deep colors or subtle noise textures.
Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Dashboard: mix square and rectangular cards.
Add 'Gold' (#D4AF37) accents subtly—only for the most premium features or 'Pro' badges.
landing_page: Hero Section: Use the abstract green wave image with a heavy dark overlay. Large Serif Headline.
Features: Use a 'Swiss Grid' layout. Large typography, lots of negative space.
Pricing: Use 'Tracing Beam' borders for the recommended plan.
dashboard: Sidebar: Deep Navy (#0B1120) with glassmorphism effect.
Cards: Flat white (light mode) or Deep Slate (dark mode) with 1px subtle borders.
Charts: Use Recharts with the custom Emerald/Gold palette.
Market Tracker: Use a 'Ticker' style component with Mono font.
accessibility: Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards.
Interactive elements must have a focus ring (Emerald-500).
Do not rely on color alone for status (use icons + text).

universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'Bootstrap' layouts. Use asymmetry and whitespace.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
